name: @tejoma/career-intelligence-service
description: Tejoma Career Intelligence Service - Tier 0 (Batch 30, sixth slice of the Matching domain). Owns career_trajectories - job-sequence normalization, progression/transition analysis, stability/domain analysis, trajectory embedding, and rule-based future-role prediction, computed from a candidate's work history. Owns a dual-written mirror of role_profiles (a second independent mirror alongside Role Intelligence Service's own - each service owns its own isolated copy). Triggered by the monolith as a shadow-validation call (SHADOW_CAREER_INTELLIGENCE_ENABLED) alongside the monolith's own unchanged computation - not yet the production source of truth. career_trajectories itself has real live readers still on the monolith (careerWeighting.ts, explainability/computeExplanation.ts) - this service's own copy is independent, not a mirror of the monolith's table.
